adopt: Turn speech into text and text into speech, on a service you host.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
An agent that can only read text is deaf and mute. Every route to fixing that today is a vendor SDK that wants the audio uploaded, an API key, and a per-minute bill -- which rules it out for exactly the recordings people most want transcribed.

Install
pip install awvoice

Commands
  awvoice

Quick start
  pip install awvoice
  pip install "awvoice[local]" # the Aither voice on this machine, no service
  awvoice say --voice local:aither "Welcome to Aitherium." # -> awvoice-say.wav

In Claude Code
  hook (Stop)            awvoice reply
  skill                  /awvoice

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awvoice/
